entityFieldPolicy: All ten complete canonical Driver records,20 RELATED_SEARCH aliases and empty crosswalk read. Definitions, mechanisms, scales, direction, modifiability/volatility, timing, measurement, caveats, sources, narratives, interactions and missingness retained. No canonical fields repaired.
rdsReview: No Family RDS; identity profiles are not automatically RDS or freely scalar. No direct RDS or RelationalState target.
causalGateReview: Six Driver→Driver incident causal claims STANDARD_CAUSAL; five new primary reviews and one F05 reused. Existing scientific content unchanged.

layersConsidered.BIO: Arousal evidence concerns fusion-related action amplification, not durable fusion creation; no dosing or BIO-F01 work.
layersConsidered.PSY: Personal-value writing, dissonance task, crisis recall, salience versus centrality and global versus identity-specific threat separated.
layersConsidered.SOC: Group identification, cooperation, breakup and shared crises; relational circumstances are not identity constructs or network metrics.
layersConsidered.CUL: Honor-culture insult evidence separates randomized insult from nonrandom regional cultural upbringing; collective narrative and actual exposure differ.
layersConsidered.ENV: Environmental identity cues and collective crises considered; observation of event not proof of later identity effects.
layersConsidered.INS: Institutional gender composition/assigned roles may cue threat; demographic membership, vigilance, belonging and identity threat not identical.
layersConsidered.INF: Value writing, counterattitudinal statements and voter wording examined; informational operation does not guarantee identity uptake.
layersConsidered.TEC: Avatar embodiment and online recall/task delivery; modeled avatar modification not automatic real identity change.

domainsConsidered.DELIBERATE_INTERVENTION: Three research-task identities; all effects RN after exact construct/time/source scrutiny.
domainsConsidered.ROUTINE_UNINTENDED_HUMAN_ACTIVITY: Everyday self-description, behavior repetition, value reflection and relational feedback considered; reverse causality and shared report possible.
domainsConsidered.EXTERNAL_EVENT_SHOCK: Crises/war and breakup considered; repeated cross-sectional samples not within-person causality.
domainsConsidered.ENVIRONMENTAL_EXPOSURE: Threatening/reminder settings may cue identities; exact isolated setting effect not retained.
domainsConsidered.INSTITUTIONAL_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: Gender composition and identity-related assignment contexts; opportunity and subjective threat separated.
domainsConsidered.TECHNOLOGICAL_CHANGE: Avatar and online task affordance studies; self-objectification proxy not durable Behavioral Self-Identity.
domainsConsidered.SOCIAL_NETWORK_EVENT_PROCESS: Group narratives, cooperation and breakup; no social tie/PSYWERX Relationship confusion.
domainsConsidered.INFORMATIONAL_EXPOSURE: Value/counterattitude/voter/crisis text cues; exposure and independently measured construct uptake differ.
domainsConsidered.BIOLOGICAL_PHYSIOLOGICAL_PROCESS: Arousal and physiological insult outcomes considered; downstream physiological response not source identity-change evidence.

propertyPolicy: All eleven properties considered explicitly. LEVEL does not imply whole-profile change or enduring trait change. Temporary salience, criterion-specific threat and enduring centrality/fusion need separate timing. No supported-null equivalence or STRUCTURE target forced.
relationshipPropertyReview: All six exact incident claims reviewed before Pass B. Honor/centrality interactions not sufficient independent exact-edge moderation; no formal pathway, relationship-targeted effect or B/C duplicate contribution.

skepticalReview.method: Independent second pass contrasting original/replication/correction, causal design versus repeated cross-section, and source result consistency against exact canonical construct/time.
checks: Value affirmation benefits on self-compassion/wellbeing not direct global-threat effect; Senegal pride-recall null kept outside exact identity.
Private high-choice writing discomfort evidence retained, but noisy free-choice preference spreading not independent evidence of dissonance.
Fusion recall immediate score does not establish enduring trait; source F versus summary means/SD discrepancy unresolved.
Repeated cross-sectional crisis waves not longitudinal persons; mathematical model not empirical causal evidence.
Social-identification profile includes centrality; no whole-profile→component causal shortcut.
Voter wording original positive and field-replication nondetection/correction preserved without durable identity inference.
Culture, gender membership and avatar operation not psychological construct by definition; no practitioner permission.
skepticalReview.remainingRisks: Profile component normalization, source-result discrepancies, exact threat/discomfort measures, enduring fusion time scale and source-alignment backlog. All three effects RN.
